localOnly.title: Available in local mode or with the server
localOnly.description: Billing and cash record accounting entries: they are not simulated. Enable local mode (VITE_LOCAL_MODE=true) or connect the CERO HEALTH server.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Invoices, patient and payer shares, payments

cash.subtitle: Patient collections by payment method
cash.orgReceiptsHint: Tracked separately: never mixed with patient cash

form.rejectTransfer: What happens to the rejected amount
form.rejectDispute: Dispute to follow up with the payer
form.cancelHint: An invoice with payments cannot be cancelled: reverse the payments first. Cancellation is traced and final.

detail.title: Invoice
detail.needsAuthorization: Prior authorization required: not applied, charged to the patient

new.title: New invoice
new.description: The price is computed as of today with the patient's validated rights.
new.primaryHint: Only one primary coverage per care episode.
new.secondaryHint: Applied only if both contracts allow it.
new.episodeHint: Ceilings and deductibles accumulate within one episode.

preview.title: Price preview
preview.failed: The price could not be computed.
preview.notConfirmed: Preview only, nothing saved. Only a coverage validated with a trace is applied.

patient.noCoverage: No coverage on file: private tariff.

insurance.title: Insurance and tariffs
insurance.subtitle: Payers, contracts, patient coverages, subscriptions, catalog and fee validity
insurance.receivablesHint: A payer receivable is never a cash receipt.

contract.label: Title
contract.editHint: Editing a contract NEVER affects invoices already issued: they keep the snapshot of the rules applied.
contract.rulesHint: The most specific rule wins: service > category > general. The rate applies to the negotiated tariff.

cov.createHint: The coverage is created as “pending”: it grants no rights until a traced validation happens.
cov.validateHint: The decision is recorded with your name and the time.
cov.authHint: Number supplied by the payer. Without a reference, no authorization is recorded.
cov.noAuthItems: This contract requires prior authorization for no specific service.
cov.neverConfirmed: A coverage is never considered confirmed without a traced validation.

sub.membersHint: Hold Ctrl (or Cmd) to pick several.
sub.notFullCover: A subscriber is NOT 100% covered by default: only the free visits, included categories and discounts of the subscription terms apply.

catalog.codeHint: The code does not change: contracts refer to it.
catalog.hint: The private tariff is the reference. Negotiated tariffs are set in contracts. A change does not affect existing invoices.

statement.title: Statement — {{name}}
statement.empty: No invoice for this organization in this period.

validity.rule: Computed in calendar months, on the facility's civil days, end date included.

modes.clamp: Same day of month, moved back to the last day if needed
modes.endOfMonth: Until the end of the arrival month

validity.modesHelp: Examples for 1 month. “Same day”: from 31 January → last day of February; from 15 January → 15 February. “End of arrival month”: from 15 January → last day of February.
validity.nonRetroactive: A change is never retroactive: payments already recorded keep their expiry date.
validity.exemptHint: Restricted to authorized people. The reason and the author are kept.

catalogManager.codeHint: Suggested automatically; letters, digits and hyphens.

laboratory.label: Test name
laboratory.hint: Laboratory tests available for ordering, with their price.

problem.codeInvalid: Invalid code: 2 to 20 letters, digits or hyphens.
problem.labelLength: The name must be 2 to 120 characters long.

packaging.title: Packaging and sale units
packaging.hint: Main unit = what you receive and sell whole (the box, the bottle). Base unit = the smallest unit you count in stock (the tablet, the ml). Stock is kept in the base unit, so you can bill 1 box, 3 tablets, 1 sachet…
packaging.perPackHint: Number of base units in one main unit (e.g. 100 tablets in 1 box). Leave 1 if the product is sold per unit.

group.title: Combined invoice payment
group.description: {{count}} unpaid invoice(s), total due {{amount}}. The amount is spread over each invoice, oldest first.
group.amountHint: A partial payment is allowed: it settles the oldest invoices first.

orgPay.title: Grouped payment — {{name}}
orgPay.description: {{members}} member(s), {{invoices}} open invoice(s). Left to collect: {{amount}}. Each invoice gets its own settlement entry: you can pay in part, leave members at zero or pay in several instalments.
orgPay.search: Search a member or an invoice
orgPay.empty: No invoice awaiting settlement for this organisation.

lump.label: Amount received from the organisation
lump.hint: Enter the total received, choose how to spread it, then adjust any line.
lump.tooBig: This amount exceeds the total due for the displayed members ({{due}}).

orgPay.amountError: Invalid amount or above the balance ({{due}}).
orgPay.summary: To record: {{amount}} for {{members}} member(s) and {{invoices}} invoice(s). Left due afterwards: {{rest}}.

catalogImport.title: Import tests and prices
catalogImport.help: Add new tests and update prices, names and status of existing ones. Everything is checked and previewed before saving: a single error blocks the import.
catalogImport.columns: Columns: Code (optional — generated if missing), Test, Price (required for a new test) and Active (yes/no, optional). A row whose code or name already exists updates that test.
catalogImport.summary: {{file}}: {{created}} to create, {{updated}} to update, {{unchanged}} unchanged, {{errors}} error(s).
catalogImport.errorsTitle: Errors to fix in the file
catalogImport.fixFirst: Fix the file and load it again: nothing is saved while an error remains.

read.notXlsx: This file is not a readable Excel workbook (.xlsx).
read.unsupported: This browser cannot read this compressed workbook. Save it again as a standard .xlsx or use a recent browser.

fatal.missingColumns: Columns not found: at least “Test” (or “Code”) and “Price” are required. Use the template.
fatal.empty: The file has no row to import.
fatal.tooMany: Too many rows: {{max}} at most per import.
